Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all we have from this game. India Women have sealed the series in an emphatic style and will be aiming to complete a whitewash, whereas England Women will be looking to finish the ODI series on a positive note. The third and final ODI will be played at the Home of Cricket, Lord's on Saturday 24th September. The action is all set to begin at 3.30 pm IST (10.00 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. For now, it's goodbye.

Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women is also the Player of the Match. She says that when they came to England their goal was to win the series. Adds that whenever she is leading she is always in the game and she is really enjoying her role. Mentions that it was not easy to bat early in the innings as the bowlers were bowling well, but later on, she was well-set and gave herself the freedom to play all those shots towards the end. Says that all the bowlers, who came to bowl provided them with the breakthrough. On Jhulan Goswami she says that she might announce her retirement at Lord's, they feel great to have a senior like her on the team and they will miss her. Concludes by saying that the last game is very special firstly because it is being played at Lord's and secondly cause Jhulan Goswami will play her final game there.

Amy Jones the skipper of England Women says it is a tough loss but she feels they didn't switch and lacked some big partnership. Adds that Harmanpreet Kaur was finding the boundary everywhere. Reckons it will be a great learning for the bowlers as they are a young group. Shares that there is inexperience in the bowling side and coming up against India was always going to be challenging. Adds there is still a game to play and hopes to turn things around. Says it's been a long season and they want to turn up for the last game at Lord's.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the game, India Women were put in to bat first and that turned out to be a blessing in disguise. They scored a mammoth total of 333, courtesy of a world-class knock of 143 from the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur. All the English bowlers were taken to the cleaners. They also gave away 24 wides while bowling. It was always going to be a mountain to climb for England Women after the first innings. They did put in a fight while batting, but none of their batters stuck around till the end. Eventually, they were defeated by 88 runs.

India Women got off to a bright start as they grabbed three wickets within the first Powerplay and put England Women under the pump early on in the innings. Post that, the English batters, Alice Capsey and Danni Wyatt steadied the ship with a 55-run stand before the former perished after a positive start. Danni Wyatt continued her merry way and stitched another solid stand of 65 runs with skipper, Amy Jones. However, once that partnership was broken England lost wickets in a heap and let the game slip away. It was Renuka Singh who grabbed four wickets for India and destroyed the batting lineup. The English tail did wag a little and delayed the inevitable, but they saved England Women from suffering a heavier defeat.

It's been yet another dominant performance from the visitors. They have not only clinched the game but have also secured a series in England after 1999! India Women had made it clear they want to win the series only for the evergreen, Jhulan Goswami and she certainly will get a winning farewell. Well for, England Women they have lost a bilateral series for the first time since 2007. A lot to ponder for them now.

OUT! STUMPED! India Women women win the series! Dayalan Hemalatha floats this full and outside off. Dean dances down the track as she looks to smash it across but misses and Yastika Bhatia has a simple job behind the stumps. An excellent win for India as they win by 88 runs.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Dayalan Hemalatha

Tossed up, around off. Blocked out.

Commentary.Commentary: Just short! Tossed up, outside off. Kemp lofts it without much timing. The ball again falls short of the fielder at long on. One.
Outside off, guided to point.
Around off, pushed through covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! A full toss, outside off. Kemp slaps it through covers for a boundary. A gift from Singh.
Three byes! Flatter and outside off, slower again. Kemp looks to cut but the ball was too close for her. The keeper lets it through her legs and the batters take three runs.

Commentary.Commentary: In the air but safe! Tossed up, full and on middle. Kemp dances down the track and lofts it high in the air. The ball falls way short of Shafali Verma who runs in from long on.

Freya Kemp comes in.

OUT! TIMBER!  Renuka Singh comes back into attack and strikes! She sends the well-set Danni Wyatt back to the hut. A lovely delivery. An inswinging yorker, around middle. Danni Wyatt fails to dig this one out and the ball goes on to hit the stumps. Renuka Singh grabs her third wicket and England Women have lost half their side.

Deepti Sharma goes back to bowling short, around off. Amy Jones punches it off the back foot towards cover. Only a single.
FOUR! Super shot! Great use of the feet. A fuller one this time, around off. Amy Jones shimmies down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it down the ground for a boundary.
Another short one, this one stays low, outside off. Amy Jones cuts this one last and to the fielder at point. Sh wanted a single there, but is sent back.
Wide of off, short in length. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards sweeper cover and takes a run.
Another length ball, angling in, around middle. Amy Jones miscues her drive to the fielder at mid on. A dot to end the over.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Amy Jones knocks it past the bowler and towards mid off. Two dots in row now.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle and leg. Amy Jones tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

A length ball, around off. Danni Wyatt gets on top of that one and pushes it towards cover.

DRINKS! England Women are motoring along nicely. They have done well to build yet another promising stand and will hope these two take the game deep. India on the other hand need to put an extra effort of else soon the game will go away from them.

A fuller ball, around off. Amy Jones steps down the pitch and strokes it down to long off and takes a single.

A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Danni Wyatt works it away through mid-wicket. A single taken.

Good-length delivery, around middle and off. Alice Capsey dabs it towards point.
FOUR! Alice Capsey is only dealing in boundaries here. Another pitched-up delivery, outside off. Alice Capsey drives it past the diving fielder at cover for another four.
FOUR! Her third boundary already. Good timing on that one. A fuller ball, around middle and leg, angling in. Alice Capsey flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Nipping in, a length ball, around middle. Alice Capsey blocks it out towards cover.
Tight single! A fuller ball, around off. Emma Lamb prods forward and pushes it towards cover. She scampers across to the other end. There is a throw at the keeper's end, but Alice Capsey is well in.
Good stop! On a length, wide of off. Emma Lamb cuts it towards cover-point. Smriti Mandhana there dives to her left and makes a terrific stop.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This time through the off side. Another pitched-up delivery, outside off. Alice Capsey leans in and drives it through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Alice Capsey is off the mark with a boundary. A fuller ball, around her pads. Alice Capsey closes the face of her bat and flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Alice Capsey looks to drive this but the ball goes off her inner half towards mid on.
Alice Capsey comes in now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Renuka Singh strikes and she gets rid of the dangerous, Sophia Dunkley. A peach of a delivery from her. On a length, nipping back in, around middle. Sophia Dunkley looks to heave this one but she misses. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Sophia Dunkley cannot believe it. She is fuming, but she has to take the long walk back.
A fuller ball, angling in, around off. Sophia Dunkley drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Outside off, a length ball. Sophia Dunkley looks to cut this away but she misses.
FOUR! Crunched! Pitches this one up, outside off. Emma Lamb drives this one away from her body and through cover for a boundary.
Outside off, a length delivery. Sophia Dunkley steps down the pitch and cuts it away from the diving fielder at backward point. A single taken.
Angling down leg, another length ball. Sophia Dunkley misses her flick. A huge shout for caught behind but the umpire disagrees. No wide given there. Surprising, as that missed her pads as well.
Swing and a miss! Width on offer, shorter ball. Sophia Dunkley looks to slash this one away but she misses.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley steers it towards short third man. No run there.
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Sophia Dunkley blocks it out watchfully.
On a length, outside off. Emma Lamb pushes it towards cover.
Emma Lamb walks out to the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bullseye from Harmanpreet Kaur! India Women have got their first breakthrough via a direct hit from the skipper. Tammy Beaumont departs for a timid score. A fuller ball, around middle, angling in. Tammy Beaumont miscues her drive towards mid on and she scampers across to the other end. Harmanpreet Kaur runs forward, grabs the ball from her right hand, and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Tammy Beaumont was well out of her crease.
Shouts of two and Tammy Beaumont will get two. On a length, angling in, on the pads. Tammy Beaumont works it away through square leg for a brace.
On a length, tailing back in, around middle. Emma Lamb flicks it aerially towards fine leg for a single.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle. Emma Lamb covers the line of the ball and defends it out.
Renuka Singh begins with a fuller ball, swinging in, around off. Emma Lamb pushes it towards mid off.
Who will bowl from the other end? Renuka Singh it is!
Outside off, a length ball. Tammy Beaumont leans forward and blocks it out watchfully. 4 runs off the first over.
FOUR! England Women and Tammy Beaumont are up and running in style. Slightly shorter, around middle. Tammy Beaumont picks up the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitches it up again, around middle, angling in. Tammy Beaumont lunges forward and blocks it out solidly.
Fuller now, around off. Tammy Beaumont presses forward and blocks it out towards cover.
Beaten! Lovely delivery. On a length now, nipping away a tad, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leans in to drive this one but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Jhulan Goswami begins with a fuller ball, swinging in, around off. Tammy Beaumont blocks it out towards point.
